native_result.symbol_obligation: The future source-owned one-passive-pin symbol must also set duplicate_pin_numbers_are_jumpers=yes; KiCad transfers jumper settings from symbol to footprint. No source schematic is integrated in this task. An explicit two-pin jumper group is another supported representation but was not independently tested here.
native_result.XFCN_comparison: Existing XFCN_T34069 footprint has four pads1 but duplicate_pad_numbers_are_jumpers=no. Do not infer its off-board connectivity from matching numbers or silently change released terminals.
